-- https://stclintrialdev1.blob.core.windows.net/cr-synapsetest/customer/region_20260623.csv

create table Region
(
    region_id int,
    region_code varchar (100),
    region_name varchar (100),
    country varchar (100),
    sub_region varchar (100),
    regional_manager varchar (100),
    created_date date
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,

    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);

-- DISTRIBUTION Type
--  1) Hash Key 
--  1) ROUND_ROBIN
--  3) Replicate
